Packing a school tiffin every morning can be a challenge, especially when you want something that is tasty, exciting and a little different from the everyday meal!
In this video, discover 6 fun and delicious tiffin ideas that are easy to make with everyday ingredients. From a fun Pinwheel Aloo Paratha and creamy Protein Dip to crunchy Peri Peri Nuts, cheesy Paneer Quesadilla, fresh Tangy Chickpea Salad and Chatpata Makhana, there’s something for every little foodie!
